messages.content:
ある質問が、次の候補のうちどれについて尋ねているかを判定してください。

質問: wikictl のソースコードにおいて、フロントマターのエイリアスリストに項目を追加する処理を行う関数は、どのファイルに定義されていますか。

候補:
A. CheckPath returns nil when p can be a page path: a .md suffix and, without it, every component accepted by CheckName. The length of a name is checked with the suffix, which is part of the file name.
B. named returns the page p with only its path issues and the title from the file name.
C. isLinksHeading reports whether t is "## Links" followed only by white space.
D. AddAlias appends alias to the aliases list of the frontmatter, creating the list if needed. The aliases node is located with the YAML parser and only the text around it is edited, so other keys and comments are kept as they are. The content is returned unchanged when the alias is already present, wh
E. fenceLine reports whether t, indented by up to three spaces, starts with three or more backticks or tildes. marker is that run of backticks or tildes, and info the rest of t.
F. checkFrontmatter enforces the frontmatter limits before the YAML parser runs. The depth is counted on the lexer tokens, whose cost is linear in the input: an open flow collection adds one level, and so does each block sequence entry or mapping key indented further than the enclosing one.
G. isHeading reports whether l is a heading outside code fences: one to six "#" at the start of the line, followed by white space.
H. topLevelPairs returns the pairs of the mapping that the frontmatter is, or nothing when it holds no pair.

- 質問の内容に最も合う候補の記号を choice に書く。
- 二つ以上の候補が同じくらい当てはまり、質問だけではどれか決められないときは ambiguous を true にする。
- reason に判断の理由を短く書く。
JSON で答えてください。

content: {"choice": "D", "ambiguous": false, "reason": "候補Dの 'AddAlias appends alias to the aliases list of the frontmatter' という記述が、質問の『フロントマターのエイリアスリストに項目を追加する処理』と完全に一致するため。"}
